# Frontend instructions

Before any significant frontend change, read:

- `/AGENTS.md`
- `/m4n-frontend/AGENTS.md`
- `/docs/FRONTEND_ARCHITECTURE.md`

For UI/form, API, or testing work, also follow the matching rows in
`/AGENTS.md`. This file only routes frontend paths; detailed rules and skill
policy remain in the referenced docs.
